title.en: IELTS Listening: The test, and forms with names and numbers
title.uz: IELTS Listening: Test tuzilishi, ism va raqamli anketalar
title.ru: IELTS Listening: Формат теста и анкеты с именами и числами

body.en:
The Listening test has 4 parts with 10 questions each, about 30 minutes in all, and you hear each recording once.
Part 1 is a conversation about an everyday matter: booking a room, joining a club, reporting a lost bag. Your job is often to complete a form.
1. Before the recording starts, read the form and say what kind of word each gap needs: a name, a number, a date or a place.
2. Names are usually spelled letter by letter. "Double L" means two Ls together.
3. Numbers are often said digit by digit: "one four" is 14, not 40.
4. The answers come in the same order as the gaps.
5. Keep to the word limit. An answer with too many words loses the mark, and so does a wrong spelling.
body.uz:
Listening testi 4 qismdan iborat, har birida 10 ta savol, jami taxminan 30 daqiqa; har bir yozuvni bir marta eshitasiz.
Part 1 — kundalik masala haqidagi suhbat: xona band qilish, klubga yozilish, yoʻqolgan sumka haqida xabar berish. Koʻpincha siz anketani toʻldirasiz.
1. Yozuv boshlanishidan oldin anketani oʻqing va har bir boʻsh joyga qanday soʻz kerakligini ayting: ism, raqam, sana yoki joy.
2. Ismlar odatda harfma-harf aytiladi. «Double L» — ikkita L yonma-yon degani.
3. Raqamlar koʻpincha bittalab aytiladi: «one four» — bu 14, 40 emas.
4. Javoblar boʻsh joylar tartibida keladi.
5. Soʻz chegarasiga rioya qiling. Soʻzi ortiqcha javob ham, imlosi xato javob ham ball bermaydi.
body.ru:
В Listening 4 части по 10 вопросов, всего около 30 минут, и каждую запись вы слышите один раз.
Part 1 — разговор о бытовом деле: забронировать зал, записаться в клуб, сообщить о потерянной сумке. Часто нужно заполнить анкету.
1. До начала записи прочитайте анкету и скажите, какое слово нужно в каждый пропуск: имя, число, дата или место.
2. Имена обычно диктуют по буквам. «Double L» значит две L подряд.
3. Числа часто называют по цифрам: «one four» — это 14, а не 40.
4. Ответы идут в том же порядке, что и пропуски.
5. Соблюдайте лимит слов. Ответ с лишними словами не засчитывается, как и ответ с ошибкой в написании.

body.en:
Listen to the man joining a library.
Gap: Surname: ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Predict: a surname, so listen for spelling.
2. He says: "Okafor. That's O-K-A-F-O-R."
3. Write the letters you hear, in order. Answer: Okafor.
Now you. Gap: Postcode: ______ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Predict: letters and numbers, said one by one.
2. Listen for the librarian's question about it, and for the answer after it.
3. Write it as you hear it. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Kutubxonaga yozilayotgan erkakni tinglang.
Boʻsh joy: Surname: ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Taxmin qiling: familiya, demak harflashni kuting.
2. U aytadi: «Okafor. That’s O-K-A-F-O-R».
3. Eshitgan harflaringizni tartib bilan yozing. Javob: Okafor.
Endi siz. Boʻsh joy: Postcode: ______ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Taxmin qiling: harf va raqamlar, bittalab aytiladi.
2. Kutubxonachining shu haqdagi savolini va undan keyingi javobni tinglang.
3. Eshitganingizdek yozing. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте, как мужчина записывается в библиотеку.
Пропуск: Surname: ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Предскажите: фамилия, значит, ждите диктовки по буквам.
2. Он говорит: «Okafor. That's O-K-A-F-O-R».
3. Запишите услышанные буквы по порядку. Ответ: Okafor.
Теперь вы. Пропуск: Postcode: ______ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Предскажите: буквы и цифры, по одной.
2. Слушайте вопрос библиотекаря об этом и ответ после него.
3. Запишите так, как услышали. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: in Part 1 people correct themselves, and the first thing they say is often wrong.
Example: "We'll need six chairs. No, eight, my cousins are coming." The answer is 8.
Listen for the small words that bring a change: no, sorry, actually, I mean, wait, make that.
So do not write the first number you hear and stop listening. Wait for the end of the sentence.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: Part 1 da odamlar oʻzini tuzatadi va birinchi aytilgan narsa koʻpincha notoʻgʻri boʻladi.
Misol: «We’ll need six chairs. No, eight, my cousins are coming». Javob — 8.
Oʻzgarishni bildiradigan kichik soʻzlarni tinglang: no, sorry, actually, I mean, wait, make that.
Demak, birinchi eshitgan raqamni yozib, tinglashni toʻxtatmang. Gap oxirigacha kuting.
body.ru:
Осторожно: в Part 1 люди поправляют себя, и первое сказанное часто неверно.
Пример: «We'll need six chairs. No, eight, my cousins are coming». Ответ — 8.
Слушайте маленькие слова, за которыми следует поправка: no, sorry, actually, I mean, wait, make that.
Поэтому не записывайте первое услышанное число и не переставайте слушать. Дождитесь конца фразы.

title.en: IELTS Listening: Notes, tables and the answer that changes
title.uz: IELTS Listening: Qaydlar, jadvallar va oʻzgaradigan javob
title.ru: IELTS Listening: Заметки, таблицы и ответ, который меняется

body.en:
Notes and tables are shorter than what the speakers say. A note like "Cost for students: £___" stands for a whole sentence.
1. Read the words around each gap: they tell you the kind of answer. After "£" comes a number; after "bring a" comes a thing.
2. Look at the headings of a table: the column tells you what the gap is (a price, a day, a time).
3. The speakers may say the words of the note in a different order, or with other words: "you pay the guide on the day" fits "Pay: on the day".
4. Check the grammar of your answer: if the note says "two ___", you need a plural.
body.uz:
Qaydlar va jadvallar soʻzlovchilar aytganidan qisqaroq. «Cost for students: £___» kabi qayd butun bir gap oʻrnida turadi.
1. Har bir boʻsh joy atrofidagi soʻzlarni oʻqing: ular javob turini koʻrsatadi. «£» dan keyin son, «bring a» dan keyin narsa keladi.
2. Jadval sarlavhalariga qarang: ustun boʻsh joy nima ekanini aytadi (narx, kun, vaqt).
3. Soʻzlovchilar qayddagi soʻzlarni boshqa tartibda yoki boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytishi mumkin: «you pay the guide on the day» — «Pay: on the day» ga mos.
4. Javobingiz grammatikasini tekshiring: qaydda «two ___» boʻlsa, koʻplik kerak.
body.ru:
Заметки и таблицы короче того, что говорят. Заметка вроде «Cost for students: £___» заменяет целое предложение.
1. Читайте слова вокруг пропуска: они подсказывают тип ответа. После «£» идёт число, после «bring a» — предмет.
2. Смотрите на заголовки таблицы: столбец говорит, что в пропуске (цена, день, время).
3. Говорящие могут сказать слова заметки в другом порядке или другими словами: «you pay the guide on the day» подходит к «Pay: on the day».
4. Проверьте грамматику ответа: если в заметке «two ___», нужно множественное число.

body.en:
Listen to a call to a tourist office.
Note: The walk starts at the ______ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS)
1. Predict: a place.
2. She says: "It starts at the castle gate. Last year it started at the museum."
3. The museum was last year. Answer: castle gate.
Now you. Table: Students | £______ (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Predict: a price, a number after "£".
2. Listen for the prices: there are two, one for adults and one for students.
3. Write the one in the students' row. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Turistik ofisga qilingan qoʻngʻiroqni tinglang.
Qayd: The walk starts at the ______ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS)
1. Taxmin qiling: joy.
2. U aytadi: «It starts at the castle gate. Last year it started at the museum».
3. Muzey — oʻtgan yili edi. Javob: castle gate.
Endi siz. Jadval: Students | £______ (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Taxmin qiling: narx, «£» dan keyingi son.
2. Narxlarni tinglang: ikkitasi bor, biri kattalarga, biri talabalarga.
3. Talabalar qatoridagisini yozing. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте звонок в туристический офис.
Заметка: The walk starts at the ______ (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS)
1. Предскажите: место.
2. Она говорит: «It starts at the castle gate. Last year it started at the museum».
3. Музей был в прошлом году. Ответ: castle gate.
Теперь вы. Таблица: Students | £______ (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Предскажите: цена, число после «£».
2. Слушайте цены: их две, для взрослых и для студентов.
3. Запишите ту, что в строке студентов. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: a speaker can give an answer and then change it, because of a mistake or new information.
Example: "The bus leaves at nine. Oh, sorry, that's the weekday time. On Saturdays it's ten." On a Saturday, the answer is ten.
The first answer is often there on purpose, to catch you. Listen for: sorry, wait, that's the old ..., this year, now.
Write the answer only when the speaker has finished the point.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: soʻzlovchi javobni aytib, keyin uni oʻzgartirishi mumkin — xato yoki yangi maʼlumot sababli.
Misol: «The bus leaves at nine. Oh, sorry, that’s the weekday time. On Saturdays it’s ten». Shanba kuni javob — ten.
Birinchi javob koʻpincha sizni chalgʻitish uchun ataylab aytiladi. Quyidagilarni tinglang: sorry, wait, that’s the old ..., this year, now.
Javobni soʻzlovchi fikrini tugatgandan keyingina yozing.
body.ru:
Осторожно: говорящий может назвать ответ, а потом изменить его — из-за ошибки или новой информации.
Пример: «The bus leaves at nine. Oh, sorry, that's the weekday time. On Saturdays it's ten». В субботу ответ — ten.
Первый ответ часто звучит нарочно, чтобы сбить вас. Слушайте: sorry, wait, that's the old ..., this year, now.
Записывайте ответ, только когда говорящий закончил мысль.

title.en: IELTS Listening: One speaker, signposts and choices
title.uz: IELTS Listening: Bitta soʻzlovchi, ishora soʻzlar va tanlov
title.ru: IELTS Listening: Один говорящий, слова-ориентиры и выбор

body.en:
Part 2 is one speaker talking about an everyday place or event: a farm, a park, a festival, a club.
1. Before it starts, read the questions and underline the key words. They tell you what to listen for.
2. Follow the signposts. Words like first, after that, now, finally and one more thing tell you that a new point, and often a new question, is coming.
3. In multiple choice, more than one option is usually mentioned. Choose the one that answers the question.
4. In matching, there are more options than you need, and the same option list is used for several questions.
body.uz:
Part 2 — kundalik joy yoki tadbir haqida gapirayotgan bitta soʻzlovchi: ferma, park, festival, klub.
1. Boshlanishidan oldin savollarni oʻqing va kalit soʻzlarning tagiga chizing. Ular nimani tinglash kerakligini aytadi.
2. Ishora soʻzlarni kuzating. First, after that, now, finally va one more thing kabi soʻzlar yangi fikr, koʻpincha yangi savol kelayotganini bildiradi.
3. Multiple choice da odatda bir nechta variant tilga olinadi. Savolga javob beradiganini tanlang.
4. Matching da variantlar kerakligidan koʻp boʻladi va bitta roʻyxat bir nechta savol uchun ishlatiladi.
body.ru:
Part 2 — один говорящий рассказывает о бытовом месте или событии: ферма, парк, фестиваль, клуб.
1. До начала прочитайте вопросы и подчеркните ключевые слова: они говорят, что слушать.
2. Следите за словами-ориентирами. First, after that, now, finally и one more thing сигналят, что начинается новая мысль, а часто и новый вопрос.
3. В multiple choice обычно звучат несколько вариантов. Выберите тот, что отвечает на вопрос.
4. В matching вариантов больше, чем нужно, и один список используется для нескольких вопросов.

body.en:
Listen to the clean-up organiser.
Question: Where will the group go after the playground?
1. Key words: "after the playground". Listen for the signpost "after that".
2. He says: "After that, we'll move on to the river bank."
3. Answer: the river bank. The car park comes "finally", if there is time.
Now you. Question: What will Tom's group collect?
1. Key words: "Tom's group".
2. Listen for the part where he names the group leaders. Three groups and three kinds of rubbish are named, one after another.
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Tozalash tadbiri tashkilotchisini tinglang.
Savol: Where will the group go after the playground?
1. Kalit soʻzlar: «after the playground». «After that» ishorasini kuting.
2. U aytadi: «After that, we’ll move on to the river bank».
3. Javob: the river bank. Avtoturargoh — «finally», vaqt qolsa.
Endi siz. Savol: What will Tom’s group collect?
1. Kalit soʻzlar: «Tom’s group».
2. U guruh rahbarlarini sanab oʻtadigan joyni tinglang. Uchta guruh va uch xil axlat ketma-ket aytiladi.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте организатора уборки.
Вопрос: Where will the group go after the playground?
1. Ключевые слова: «after the playground». Ждите ориентир «after that».
2. Он говорит: «After that, we'll move on to the river bank».
3. Ответ: the river bank. Парковка — «finally», если останется время.
Теперь вы. Вопрос: What will Tom's group collect?
1. Ключевые слова: «Tom's group».
2. Слушайте место, где он называет руководителей групп. Три группы и три вида мусора звучат подряд.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: the speaker often mentions an option and then says it is not true any more, or not true this time.
Example: "Last year everyone brought a packed lunch, but this year lunch is provided." If the question asks what to bring, the packed lunch is the trap.
Listen for: used to, last year, not any more, but this year, instead, so you don't need.
An option you heard is not the answer until you know it is still true.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: soʻzlovchi koʻpincha variantni tilga oladi, keyin u endi yoki bu safar toʻgʻri emasligini aytadi.
Misol: «Last year everyone brought a packed lunch, but this year lunch is provided». Savol nima olib kelishni soʻrasa, packed lunch — tuzoq.
Quyidagilarni tinglang: used to, last year, not any more, but this year, instead, so you don’t need.
Eshitgan variantingiz hali ham toʻgʻriligini bilmaguningizcha, u javob emas.
body.ru:
Осторожно: говорящий часто упоминает вариант, а потом говорит, что это уже неверно или неверно в этот раз.
Пример: «Last year everyone brought a packed lunch, but this year lunch is provided». Если спрашивают, что принести, packed lunch — ловушка.
Слушайте: used to, last year, not any more, but this year, instead, so you don't need.
Услышанный вариант не ответ, пока вы не знаете, что он всё ещё верен.

body.en:
In a map or plan question you write the letter of a place. Here the plan is drawn in rows: you stand at the bottom row and look up, so "on your left" is the left of each row.
1. Before the recording, find where the speaker starts: the gate, the entrance, the stairs.
2. Learn the direction words: on your left, on your right, straight ahead, opposite, next to, between, in the corner, half way up, at the far end.
3. Follow the speaker from place to place, in order. Each new place starts from the last one.
4. Look at the letters that are left: a plan has more letters than questions.
body.uz:
Xarita yoki reja savolida siz joyning harfini yozasiz. Bu yerda reja qatorlar bilan chizilgan: siz pastki qatorda turib, yuqoriga qaraysiz, shuning uchun «on your left» — har bir qatorning chap tomoni.
1. Yozuvdan oldin soʻzlovchi qayerdan boshlashini toping: darvoza, kirish, zinapoya.
2. Yoʻnalish soʻzlarini oʻrganing: on your left, on your right, straight ahead, opposite, next to, between, in the corner, half way up, at the far end.
3. Soʻzlovchini joydan joyga, tartib bilan kuzating. Har bir yangi joy oldingisidan boshlanadi.
4. Qolgan harflarga qarang: rejada harflar savollardan koʻp.
body.ru:
В вопросе по карте или плану вы пишете букву места. Здесь план нарисован рядами: вы стоите у нижнего ряда и смотрите вверх, поэтому «on your left» — левая сторона каждого ряда.
1. До записи найдите, откуда начинает говорящий: ворота, вход, лестница.
2. Выучите слова направления: on your left, on your right, straight ahead, opposite, next to, between, in the corner, half way up, at the far end.
3. Следуйте за говорящим от места к месту по порядку. Каждое новое место отсчитывается от предыдущего.
4. Смотрите на оставшиеся буквы: букв на плане больше, чем вопросов.

body.en:
Listen to the campsite warden.
Question: Where is the office?
1. Start: the entrance, in the middle of the bottom row. The shop is the first building on the left.
2. She says: "Opposite the shop, on your right, is the office."
3. Opposite the shop is across the road: bottom row, right. Answer: G.
Now you. Question: Where is the playground?
1. Start from the shower block, half way up.
2. Listen for "opposite the showers".
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Kemping qoʻriqchisini tinglang.
Savol: Where is the office?
1. Boshlanish: kirish, pastki qator oʻrtasi. Doʻkon — chapdagi birinchi bino.
2. U aytadi: «Opposite the shop, on your right, is the office».
3. Doʻkonning qarshisi — yoʻlning narigi tomoni: pastki qator, oʻngda. Javob: G.
Endi siz. Savol: Where is the playground?
1. Dush xonasidan boshlang, oʻrta qatorda.
2. «Opposite the showers» iborasini kuting.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте смотрителя кемпинга.
Вопрос: Where is the office?
1. Начало: вход, середина нижнего ряда. Магазин — первое здание слева.
2. Она говорит: «Opposite the shop, on your right, is the office».
3. Напротив магазина — через дорогу: нижний ряд, справа. Ответ: G.
Теперь вы. Вопрос: Where is the playground?
1. Начните от душевых, в среднем ряду.
2. Ждите «opposite the showers».
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: on maps, a place may have moved, or a sign may be old. The speaker says where it was and then where it is now.
Example: "The ticket office used to be by the gate, but now it's next to the café." The answer is the place next to the café.
Also check opposite and next to: opposite is across a road or a room, next to is beside it.
Listen for: used to be, the old sign, now, moved, new.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: xaritada joy koʻchgan yoki belgi eskirgan boʻlishi mumkin. Soʻzlovchi u qayerda boʻlganini, keyin hozir qayerdaligini aytadi.
Misol: «The ticket office used to be by the gate, but now it’s next to the café». Javob — kafe yonidagi joy.
Opposite va next to ni ham tekshiring: opposite — yoʻl yoki xonaning narigi tomoni, next to — yonida.
Quyidagilarni tinglang: used to be, the old sign, now, moved, new.
body.ru:
Осторожно: на карте место могло переехать, а указатель устареть. Говорящий скажет, где оно было, а потом где оно сейчас.
Пример: «The ticket office used to be by the gate, but now it's next to the café». Ответ — место рядом с кафе.
Проверяйте также opposite и next to: opposite — через дорогу или комнату, next to — рядом.
Слушайте: used to be, the old sign, now, moved, new.

title.uz: IELTS Listening: Kim nima deb oʻylaydi

body.en:
Part 3 is a discussion: two or three people, often students and a tutor, talk about a project or an assignment. The questions ask what each person thinks.
1. Before you listen, note who is who and what each question is about.
2. Listen for opinion words: useful, out of date, I don't trust, too general, the best thing.
3. Listen for agreement and disagreement: I agree, exactly, true, yes but, I'm not sure about that.
4. An opinion often needs two turns: one person says it, the other agrees or changes it. The answer is where they end up.
body.uz:
Part 3 — muhokama: ikki-uch kishi, koʻpincha talabalar va repetitor, loyiha yoki topshiriq haqida gaplashadi. Savollar har kim nima deb oʻylashini soʻraydi.
1. Tinglashdan oldin kim kimligini va har bir savol nima haqida ekanini belgilang.
2. Fikr bildiruvchi soʻzlarni tinglang: useful, out of date, I don’t trust, too general, the best thing.
3. Rozilik va norozilikni tinglang: I agree, exactly, true, yes but, I’m not sure about that.
4. Fikr koʻpincha ikki navbatda shakllanadi: biri aytadi, ikkinchisi rozi boʻladi yoki uni oʻzgartiradi. Javob — ular kelishgan fikr.
body.ru:
Part 3 — обсуждение: двое-трое, часто студенты и преподаватель, говорят о проекте или задании. Вопросы спрашивают, что думает каждый.
1. До прослушивания отметьте, кто есть кто и о чём каждый вопрос.
2. Слушайте слова мнения: useful, out of date, I don't trust, too general, the best thing.
3. Слушайте согласие и несогласие: I agree, exactly, true, yes but, I'm not sure about that.
4. Мнение часто складывается за две реплики: один говорит, другой соглашается или поправляет. Ответ — то, к чему они пришли.

body.en:
Listen to Hana and Marcus.
Question: What do they think of the architect's book?
1. Marcus: "It's beautifully written, but it's twenty years old, so most of it is out of date."
2. Hana agrees: "Yes, most of it." "Beautifully written" comes before "but", so it is not the point.
3. Answer: It is now too old.
Now you. Question: What do they think of the blog?
1. Hana first says it was great. Is that her final view?
2. Listen for what she noticed, and for Marcus's reply.
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Xana va Markusni tinglang.
Savol: What do they think of the architect’s book?
1. Markus: «It’s beautifully written, but it’s twenty years old, so most of it is out of date».
2. Xana rozi: «Yes, most of it». «Beautifully written» — «but» dan oldin, demak asosiy fikr emas.
3. Javob: It is now too old.
Endi siz. Savol: What do they think of the blog?
1. Xana avval uni zoʻr deydi. Bu uning yakuniy fikrimi?
2. U nimani payqaganini va Markusning javobini tinglang.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте Хану и Маркуса.
Вопрос: What do they think of the architect's book?
1. Маркус: «It's beautifully written, but it's twenty years old, so most of it is out of date».
2. Хана соглашается: «Yes, most of it». «Beautifully written» стоит до «but», значит, это не главное.
3. Ответ: It is now too old.
Теперь вы. Вопрос: What do they think of the blog?
1. Сначала Хана говорит, что блог отличный. Это её окончательное мнение?
2. Слушайте, что она заметила, и ответ Маркуса.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: in a discussion, the first person to speak often does not have the last word.
Example: "Let's drop the second interview." "But it's the only one with a teacher in it." "True. Let's keep it." The decision is to keep it.
Listen for the words that turn a view round: but, true, actually, you've convinced me, OK then, I'm convinced.
The question asks what they think or decide in the end, so wait for the reply.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: muhokamada birinchi gapirgan odam koʻpincha oxirgi soʻzni aytmaydi.
Misol: «Let’s drop the second interview». — «But it’s the only one with a teacher in it». — «True. Let’s keep it». Qaror — saqlab qolish.
Fikrni oʻzgartiradigan soʻzlarni tinglang: but, true, actually, you’ve convinced me, OK then, I’m convinced.
Savol oxir-oqibat nima deb oʻylashgan yoki nima qaror qilishganini soʻraydi, shuning uchun javobni kuting.
body.ru:
Осторожно: в обсуждении первый говорящий часто не говорит последнее слово.
Пример: «Let's drop the second interview». — «But it's the only one with a teacher in it». — «True. Let's keep it». Решение — оставить.
Слушайте слова, которые разворачивают мнение: but, true, actually, you've convinced me, OK then, I'm convinced.
Вопрос о том, что они думают или решают в итоге, поэтому дождитесь ответа.

body.en:
Many Part 3 questions ask what the speakers decide: a date, a method, a topic. They usually try two or three ideas before they decide.
1. Read the question and the options first. Often every option is mentioned.
2. For each idea, listen for the reason it is rejected: it's closed, it's too expensive, it takes too long, there's no room.
3. The decision comes with words like let's, OK then, we'll, agreed, that works.
4. In sentence completion, the missing word is often the last idea they agree on, said in a short reply.
body.uz:
Part 3 dagi koʻp savollar soʻzlovchilar nima qaror qilishini soʻraydi: sana, usul, mavzu. Ular odatda qaror qilishdan oldin ikki-uch gʻoyani koʻrib chiqadi.
1. Avval savol va variantlarni oʻqing. Koʻpincha har bir variant tilga olinadi.
2. Har bir gʻoya nima uchun rad etilishini tinglang: it’s closed, it’s too expensive, it takes too long, there’s no room.
3. Qaror let’s, OK then, we’ll, agreed, that works kabi soʻzlar bilan keladi.
4. Gapni toʻldirishda tushib qolgan soʻz koʻpincha ular kelishgan oxirgi gʻoya boʻladi va qisqa javobda aytiladi.
body.ru:
Многие вопросы Part 3 спрашивают, что решили говорящие: дату, способ, тему. Обычно до решения они перебирают две-три идеи.
1. Сначала прочитайте вопрос и варианты. Часто упоминается каждый вариант.
2. Для каждой идеи слушайте причину отказа: it's closed, it's too expensive, it takes too long, there's no room.
3. Решение звучит со словами let's, OK then, we'll, agreed, that works.
4. В sentence completion пропущенное слово — часто последняя идея, на которой сошлись, сказанная короткой репликой.

body.en:
Listen to Ella and Rahul planning a trip.
Question: The trip will be on the ______ of the month.
1. Ella: "the ninth". Rejected: the centre is closed on Mondays.
2. "The tenth, then?" Rejected: "We've got a test on the tenth."
3. "What about the twelfth?" "The twelfth works. Let's book it." Answer: twelfth.
Now you. Question: How will the class travel?
1. Listen to each idea: the train, the minibus, the coach.
2. For each one, find the reason they reject it, or the words that show they agree.
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Ella va Rahulning sayohatni rejalashtirishini tinglang.
Savol: The trip will be on the ______ of the month.
1. Ella: «the ninth». Rad etildi: markaz dushanba kuni yopiq.
2. «The tenth, then?» Rad etildi: «We’ve got a test on the tenth».
3. «What about the twelfth?» — «The twelfth works. Let’s book it». Javob: twelfth.
Endi siz. Savol: How will the class travel?
1. Har bir gʻoyani tinglang: poyezd, mikroavtobus, avtobus.
2. Har biri uchun rad etish sababini yoki rozilik soʻzlarini toping.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте, как Элла и Рахул планируют поездку.
Вопрос: The trip will be on the ______ of the month.
1. Элла: «the ninth». Отказ: центр закрыт по понедельникам.
2. «The tenth, then?» Отказ: «We've got a test on the tenth».
3. «What about the twelfth?» — «The twelfth works. Let's book it». Ответ: twelfth.
Теперь вы. Вопрос: How will the class travel?
1. Слушайте каждую идею: поезд, микроавтобус, автобус.
2. Для каждой найдите причину отказа или слова согласия.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: the option that is talked about most is often not the one they choose.
Example: two students spend a minute on why a museum visit would be great, and then one says, "But we can't afford the tickets. Let's use the online collection." The answer is the online collection.
A long, happy description is not a decision. Listen for the but that ends it, and for the short line that follows: let's, OK, fine, agreed.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: eng koʻp gapirilgan variant koʻpincha tanlanmaydi.
Misol: ikki talaba bir daqiqa davomida muzeyga borish naqadar zoʻrligini gapiradi, keyin biri: «But we can’t afford the tickets. Let’s use the online collection». Javob — online collection.
Uzoq va quvnoq taʼrif qaror emas. Uni toʻxtatadigan but ni va undan keyingi qisqa gapni tinglang: let’s, OK, fine, agreed.
body.ru:
Осторожно: вариант, о котором говорят больше всего, часто не выбирают.
Пример: двое студентов минуту говорят, как хорошо сходить в музей, а потом один: «But we can't afford the tickets. Let's use the online collection». Ответ — online collection.
Длинное радостное описание — не решение. Слушайте but, которое его обрывает, и короткую фразу после: let's, OK, fine, agreed.

title.en: IELTS Listening: Notes from a lecture

body.en:
Part 4 is a short lecture on an academic subject, with no break in the middle. You complete notes as the lecturer speaks.
1. Before it starts, read the headings of the notes. They follow the order of the talk.
2. Use the lecturer's signposts to keep your place: first, second, next, finally, one last point, now let's look at.
3. Predict the grammar of each gap from the words around it: after "a" or "an" comes a singular noun, after "can" a verb, after "the" and "get shorter" a plural.
4. The answer is a word you hear. Write it exactly, and check its spelling and its ending.
body.uz:
Part 4 — akademik mavzudagi qisqa maʼruza, oʻrtasida tanaffus yoʻq. Maʼruzachi gapirayotganda siz qaydlarni toʻldirasiz.
1. Boshlanishidan oldin qaydlar sarlavhalarini oʻqing. Ular nutq tartibida boradi.
2. Joyingizni yoʻqotmaslik uchun maʼruzachining ishora soʻzlaridan foydalaning: first, second, next, finally, one last point, now let’s look at.
3. Har bir boʻsh joyning grammatikasini atrofdagi soʻzlardan taxmin qiling: «a» yoki «an» dan keyin birlikdagi ot, «can» dan keyin feʼl, «the» va «get shorter» bilan koʻplik keladi.
4. Javob — eshitgan soʻzingiz. Uni aynan yozing, imlosi va qoʻshimchasini tekshiring.
body.ru:
Part 4 — короткая лекция на академическую тему, без перерыва. Вы заполняете заметки, пока лектор говорит.
1. До начала прочитайте заголовки заметок: они идут в порядке лекции.
2. Следите за словами-ориентирами лектора: first, second, next, finally, one last point, now let's look at.
3. Предсказывайте грамматику пропуска по соседним словам: после «a» или «an» — существительное в единственном числе, после «can» — глагол, с «the» и «get shorter» — множественное число.
4. Ответ — услышанное слово. Пишите его точно, проверьте написание и окончание.

body.en:
Listen to the lecture about honey.
Note: Step 2: nectar is put into the six-sided ______ of the comb (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Signpost: "Second, at the hive".
2. Grammar: after "six-sided" and before "of the comb", a plural noun.
3. She says: "put it into the six-sided cells of the comb". Answer: cells.
Now you. Note: Step 3: on a warm night, a busy hive can sound like a small ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Wait for the signpost "Third".
2. Grammar: after "a small", one noun, not a plural.
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Asal haqidagi maʼruzani tinglang.
Qayd: Step 2: nectar is put into the six-sided ______ of the comb (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Ishora: «Second, at the hive».
2. Grammatika: «six-sided» dan keyin va «of the comb» dan oldin — koʻplikdagi ot.
3. U aytadi: «put it into the six-sided cells of the comb». Javob: cells.
Endi siz. Qayd: Step 3: on a warm night, a busy hive can sound like a small ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. «Third» ishorasini kuting.
2. Grammatika: «a small» dan keyin bitta ot, koʻplik emas.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте лекцию о мёде.
Заметка: Step 2: nectar is put into the six-sided ______ of the comb (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Ориентир: «Second, at the hive».
2. Грамматика: после «six-sided» и перед «of the comb» — существительное во множественном числе.
3. Она говорит: «put it into the six-sided cells of the comb». Ответ: cells.
Теперь вы. Заметка: Step 3: on a warm night, a busy hive can sound like a small ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Ждите ориентир «Third».
2. Грамматика: после «a small» — одно существительное, не множественное число.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: an answer can be right in meaning and still lose the mark.
1. A missing plural: if the speaker says "cells", "cell" is wrong.
2. A word from the notes instead of the recording: write what you hear, not a word you think means the same.
3. Too many words: "a thin lid of wax" is five words; if the limit is ONE WORD, write only the word the gap needs.
Read your answer back in the note. It must fit the grammar and the word limit.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: javob maʼno jihatdan toʻgʻri boʻlsa ham ball bermasligi mumkin.
1. Koʻplik qoʻshimchasi tushib qolsa: soʻzlovchi «cells» desa, «cell» notoʻgʻri.
2. Yozuvdagi emas, qayddagi soʻz: oʻzingizcha maʼnodosh soʻzni emas, eshitganingizni yozing.
3. Soʻz koʻp: «a thin lid of wax» — besh soʻz; chegara ONE WORD boʻlsa, faqat boʻsh joyga kerak soʻzni yozing.
Javobingizni qaydga qoʻyib oʻqing. U grammatikaga va soʻz chegarasiga mos boʻlishi kerak.
body.ru:
Осторожно: ответ может быть верным по смыслу и всё равно не засчитаться.
1. Пропущено множественное число: если говорят «cells», то «cell» — ошибка.
2. Слово из заметок, а не из записи: пишите услышанное, а не своё слово с тем же смыслом.
3. Лишние слова: «a thin lid of wax» — пять слов; если лимит ONE WORD, пишите только слово для пропуска.
Прочитайте ответ в заметке: он должен подходить по грамматике и по лимиту слов.

title.en: IELTS Listening: Flow charts and sentences

body.en:
Lectures often describe a process: how something is made or how something happens, step by step. The test turns it into a flow chart or a set of sentences with gaps.
1. Read the whole chart first. The steps are in the same order as the talk.
2. Listen for the words that move a process on: first, after that, next, then, once, finally.
3. The sentence you read is usually a paraphrase. "Covered with banana leaves" may come as "under banana leaves".
4. Your answer must make the sentence correct grammar, so check it fits: a noun, a verb ending in -ed, a plural.
body.uz:
Maʼruzalar koʻpincha jarayonni taʼriflaydi: biror narsa qanday yasalishi yoki qanday sodir boʻlishini qadamma-qadam. Test uni blok-sxema yoki boʻsh joyli gaplarga aylantiradi.
1. Avval butun sxemani oʻqing. Qadamlar nutq tartibida boradi.
2. Jarayonni oldinga suradigan soʻzlarni tinglang: first, after that, next, then, once, finally.
3. Siz oʻqiydigan gap odatda parafraz boʻladi. «Covered with banana leaves» oʻrniga «under banana leaves» kelishi mumkin.
4. Javobingiz gapni grammatik jihatdan toʻgʻri qilishi kerak: ot, -ed bilan tugaydigan feʼl, koʻplik — mosligini tekshiring.
body.ru:
Лекции часто описывают процесс: как что-то делают или как что-то происходит, шаг за шагом. В тесте это превращается в блок-схему или предложения с пропусками.
1. Сначала прочитайте всю схему: шаги идут в том же порядке, что и лекция.
2. Слушайте слова, которые двигают процесс: first, after that, next, then, once, finally.
3. Предложение, которое вы читаете, обычно перефразировано. «Covered with banana leaves» может стать «under banana leaves».
4. Ответ должен делать предложение грамматически верным: существительное, глагол на -ed, множественное число.

body.en:
Listen to the lecture about chocolate.
Flow chart: Step 2: the beans are dried in the ______ and shipped to a factory (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Signpost: "Next".
2. He says: "the beans are dried in the sun, and then shipped to a factory".
3. Answer: sun.
Now you. Flow chart: last step: the mixture is stirred for ______ to make it smooth (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Grammar: after "stirred for", a length of time.
2. Listen for the last step, after the sugar and the milk.
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Shokolad haqidagi maʼruzani tinglang.
Blok-sxema: Step 2: the beans are dried in the ______ and shipped to a factory (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Ishora: «Next».
2. U aytadi: «the beans are dried in the sun, and then shipped to a factory».
3. Javob: sun.
Endi siz. Blok-sxema: oxirgi qadam: the mixture is stirred for ______ to make it smooth (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Grammatika: «stirred for» dan keyin vaqt davomiyligi.
2. Shakar va sutdan keyingi oxirgi qadamni tinglang.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте лекцию о шоколаде.
Блок-схема: Step 2: the beans are dried in the ______ and shipped to a factory (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Ориентир: «Next».
2. Он говорит: «the beans are dried in the sun, and then shipped to a factory».
3. Ответ: sun.
Теперь вы. Блок-схема: последний шаг: the mixture is stirred for ______ to make it smooth (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Грамматика: после «stirred for» — отрезок времени.
2. Слушайте последний шаг, после сахара и молока.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: a lecturer may name a wrong idea first, just to correct it.
Example: "Many people think the shells are what we eat, but it's the nibs that matter." If the sentence asks what is left after the shells are removed, "shells" is the trap.
Listen for: many people think, it's often said, in fact, actually, but it's ... that.
Also watch the order: the chart's next step may be said in the same sentence as the one before it.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: maʼruzachi notoʻgʻri fikrni uni tuzatish uchun avval aytishi mumkin.
Misol: «Many people think the shells are what we eat, but it’s the nibs that matter». Gap poʻchoq olib tashlangandan keyin nima qolishini soʻrasa, «shells» — tuzoq.
Quyidagilarni tinglang: many people think, it’s often said, in fact, actually, but it’s ... that.
Tartibni ham kuzating: sxemaning keyingi qadami oldingisi bilan bitta gapda aytilishi mumkin.
body.ru:
Осторожно: лектор может сначала назвать неверную мысль, чтобы её поправить.
Пример: «Many people think the shells are what we eat, but it's the nibs that matter». Если спрашивают, что остаётся после удаления скорлупы, «shells» — ловушка.
Слушайте: many people think, it's often said, in fact, actually, but it's ... that.
Следите и за порядком: следующий шаг схемы может прозвучать в той же фразе, что и предыдущий.

title.en: IELTS Listening: Paraphrase, the same idea in other words
title.uz: IELTS Listening: Parafraz — bir fikr, boshqa soʻzlar
title.ru: IELTS Listening: Перефразирование — та же мысль другими словами

body.en:
In the test, the right option almost never uses the speaker's own words. It says the same idea in other words: a paraphrase.
"The council is resurfacing the road" becomes "because of work on a road". "Something to eat" becomes "their own food".
1. Before you listen, say each option to yourself in simpler words.
2. While you listen, match meanings, not single words.
3. Be suspicious of an option that repeats a word you hear exactly. It is often a trap.
Keep a list of pairs you meet: cheap / not expensive, start / launch, closed down / no longer open.
body.uz:
Testda toʻgʻri variant deyarli hech qachon soʻzlovchining oʻz soʻzlarini takrorlamaydi. U oʻsha fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytadi — parafraz.
«The council is resurfacing the road» — «because of work on a road» boʻladi. «Something to eat» — «their own food» boʻladi.
1. Tinglashdan oldin har bir variantni oʻzingizga soddaroq soʻzlar bilan ayting.
2. Tinglayotganda alohida soʻzlarni emas, maʼnoni solishtiring.
3. Eshitgan soʻzingizni aynan takrorlaydigan variantga shubha bilan qarang. U koʻpincha tuzoq.
Uchragan juftliklar roʻyxatini yuriting: cheap / not expensive, start / launch, closed down / no longer open.
body.ru:
В тесте верный вариант почти никогда не повторяет слова говорящего. Он передаёт ту же мысль другими словами — это перефразирование.
«The council is resurfacing the road» превращается в «because of work on a road». «Something to eat» — в «their own food».
1. До прослушивания перескажите себе каждый вариант простыми словами.
2. Во время прослушивания сравнивайте смысл, а не отдельные слова.
3. Будьте осторожны с вариантом, который точно повторяет услышанное слово: часто это ловушка.
Ведите список пар: cheap / not expensive, start / launch, closed down / no longer open.

body.en:
Listen to Greg's message to the cycling club.
Question: Where will the riders meet this Saturday?
A  outside the library   B  at the sports centre car park
1. He says: "We normally meet outside the library, but ... we'll meet at the sports centre car park instead."
2. "Normally" tells you the library is the usual place, not this week's. Answer: B.
Now you. Question: What should the riders bring?
1. Listen for "bring".
2. Then ask: which option says the same idea in other words, and which only repeats a word you heard?
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Gregning velosiped klubiga yuborgan xabarini tinglang.
Savol: Where will the riders meet this Saturday?
A  outside the library   B  at the sports centre car park
1. U aytadi: «We normally meet outside the library, but ... we’ll meet at the sports centre car park instead».
2. «Normally» kutubxona odatiy joy ekanini, bu haftaniki emasligini bildiradi. Javob: B.
Endi siz. Savol: What should the riders bring?
1. «Bring» soʻzini kuting.
2. Keyin oʻylang: qaysi variant fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytadi, qaysi biri faqat eshitgan soʻzingizni takrorlaydi?
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте сообщение Грега для велоклуба.
Вопрос: Where will the riders meet this Saturday?
A  outside the library   B  at the sports centre car park
1. Он говорит: «We normally meet outside the library, but ... we'll meet at the sports centre car park instead».
2. «Normally» значит, что библиотека — обычное место, а не место на этой неделе. Ответ: B.
Теперь вы. Вопрос: What should the riders bring?
1. Ждите слово «bring».
2. Потом спросите себя: какой вариант передаёт ту же мысль другими словами, а какой лишь повторяет услышанное слово?
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out for an option that is built from the speaker's words but changes the meaning.
Example: the speaker says "the new route is shorter, but there are more hills". An option "It is longer than usual" uses the idea of length but turns it round. "It has more hills than the old plan" says the same thing in other words.
Check each option against the whole sentence, including the small words: but, not, more, less, instead, normally.
body.uz:
Soʻzlovchining soʻzlaridan tuzilgan, lekin maʼnoni oʻzgartirgan variantdan ehtiyot boʻling.
Misol: soʻzlovchi «the new route is shorter, but there are more hills» deydi. «It is longer than usual» varianti uzunlik haqidagi fikrni oladi, lekin uni teskari qiladi. «It has more hills than the old plan» esa oʻsha fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytadi.
Har bir variantni butun gap bilan, kichik soʻzlari bilan birga tekshiring: but, not, more, less, instead, normally.
body.ru:
Осторожно с вариантом, составленным из слов говорящего, но с другим смыслом.
Пример: говорящий: «the new route is shorter, but there are more hills». Вариант «It is longer than usual» берёт мысль о длине, но переворачивает её. «It has more hills than the old plan» говорит то же самое другими словами.
Сверяйте каждый вариант со всей фразой, включая маленькие слова: but, not, more, less, instead, normally.

title.en: IELTS Listening: Short answers and different accents
title.uz: IELTS Listening: Qisqa javoblar va turli aksentlar
title.ru: IELTS Listening: Краткие ответы и разные акценты

body.en:
The test uses several accents, including British, Australian, New Zealand and North American. The recordings in these lessons use British and American voices, so listen to English from other places too.
Accents change sounds and sometimes words: a return ticket and a round-trip ticket, a timetable and a schedule, a flat and an apartment.
For a short answer:
1. Find the question word: where, when, how many, what.
2. Write words you hear, within the word limit.
3. Numbers: fifteen and fifty sound alike. Listen for the stress (fifTEEN, FIFty), or for the speaker saying the digits: "five-oh".
body.uz:
Testda bir nechta aksent ishlatiladi, jumladan britan, avstraliya, Yangi Zelandiya va Shimoliy Amerika aksentlari. Bu darslardagi yozuvlarda britan va amerika ovozlari bor, shuning uchun boshqa joylardagi ingliz tilini ham tinglang.
Aksent tovushlarni, baʼzan esa soʻzlarni oʻzgartiradi: a return ticket va a round-trip ticket, a timetable va a schedule, a flat va an apartment.
Qisqa javob uchun:
1. Savol soʻzini toping: where, when, how many, what.
2. Eshitgan soʻzlaringizni soʻz chegarasida yozing.
3. Raqamlar: fifteen va fifty bir-biriga oʻxshaydi. Urgʻuga quloq soling (fifTEEN, FIFty) yoki soʻzlovchi raqamlarni aytishini kuting: «five-oh».
body.ru:
В тесте звучат разные акценты, в том числе британский, австралийский, новозеландский и североамериканский. В записях этих уроков — британские и американские голоса, поэтому слушайте английский и из других мест.
Акцент меняет звуки, а иногда и слова: a return ticket и a round-trip ticket, a timetable и a schedule, a flat и an apartment.
Для краткого ответа:
1. Найдите вопросительное слово: where, when, how many, what.
2. Пишите услышанные слова в пределах лимита.
3. Числа: fifteen и fifty звучат похоже. Слушайте ударение (fifTEEN, FIFty) или ждите, что говорящий назовёт цифры: «five-oh».

body.en:
Listen to a visitor (American) and a station worker (British).
Question: She has to change trains at ______. (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Question word: where. A place.
2. He says "change at Ashbury", and later spells it: "A-S-H-B-U-R-Y".
3. Answer: Ashbury.
Now you. Question: With the change, the journey takes ______ minutes. (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Question word: how long. A number.
2. Fifteen or fifty? Listen for how she checks it.
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Mehmon (amerikalik) va vokzal xodimi (britaniyalik)ni tinglang.
Savol: She has to change trains at ______. (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Savol soʻzi: qayerda. Joy nomi.
2. U «change at Ashbury» deydi, keyin harflaydi: «A-S-H-B-U-R-Y».
3. Javob: Ashbury.
Endi siz. Savol: With the change, the journey takes ______ minutes. (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Savol soʻzi: qancha vaqt. Son.
2. Fifteen yoki fifty? U buni qanday tekshirishini tinglang.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте пассажирку (американку) и работника станции (британца).
Вопрос: She has to change trains at ______. (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Вопрос: где. Название места.
2. Он говорит «change at Ashbury», а потом диктует: «A-S-H-B-U-R-Y».
3. Ответ: Ashbury.
Теперь вы. Вопрос: With the change, the journey takes ______ minutes. (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Вопрос: сколько времени. Число.
2. Fifteen или fifty? Слушайте, как она это уточняет.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: speakers with different accents may use different words for the same thing, and the answer is the word the recording gives for the gap.
Example: an American asks for a "round-trip ticket"; the British worker calls it "a return". If the sentence reads "ask for a ______ return", the word you need is the one before "return", not "round-trip".
Also check that your answer fits the sentence exactly: the words before and after the gap are already there, so do not write them again.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: turli aksentdagi soʻzlovchilar bitta narsani turlicha atashi mumkin, javob esa yozuvda boʻsh joy uchun aytilgan soʻz.
Misol: amerikalik «round-trip ticket» soʻraydi, britaniyalik xodim uni «a return» deydi. Gap «ask for a ______ return» boʻlsa, sizga «return» dan oldingi soʻz kerak, «round-trip» emas.
Javobingiz gapga aynan mosligini ham tekshiring: boʻsh joydan oldingi va keyingi soʻzlar allaqachon bor, ularni qayta yozmang.
body.ru:
Осторожно: люди с разными акцентами могут называть одно и то же по-разному, а ответ — то слово, которое в записи звучит для пропуска.
Пример: американка просит «round-trip ticket», британец называет его «a return». Если в предложении «ask for a ______ return», нужно слово перед «return», а не «round-trip».
Проверьте и то, что ответ точно встаёт в предложение: слова до и после пропуска уже есть, не пишите их снова.

title.uz: IELTS Listening: Faqat bir marta eshitiladi

body.en:
In the test you hear each recording once: one sitting, no pausing, no replaying. In this lesson's test, too, each clip plays once.
1. Use the time before each recording: read the questions and predict the kind of answer.
2. Keep your eyes one question ahead. The answers come in order, so the next question tells you what to listen for next.
3. If you miss an answer, let it go. Guess later, but do not stop listening, or you will miss the next one too.
4. Write short notes while you listen, and write the final answer neatly after.
body.uz:
Testda har bir yozuvni bir marta eshitasiz: bir oʻtirishda, toʻxtatmasdan, qayta tinglamasdan. Bu darsning testida ham har bir yozuv bir marta eshittiriladi.
1. Har bir yozuv oldidagi vaqtdan foydalaning: savollarni oʻqing va javob turini taxmin qiling.
2. Koʻzingiz bitta savol oldinda boʻlsin. Javoblar tartib bilan keladi, shuning uchun keyingi savol nimani tinglashni aytadi.
3. Javobni oʻtkazib yuborsangiz, uni qoʻyib yuboring. Keyin taxmin qilasiz, lekin tinglashni toʻxtatmang, aks holda keyingisini ham oʻtkazib yuborasiz.
4. Tinglayotganda qisqa qayd yozing, yakuniy javobni keyin toza yozing.
body.ru:
В тесте каждую запись вы слышите один раз: один подход, без пауз и повторов. В тесте этого урока каждый клип тоже звучит один раз.
1. Используйте время перед записью: прочитайте вопросы и предскажите тип ответа.
2. Держите взгляд на один вопрос впереди. Ответы идут по порядку, поэтому следующий вопрос подсказывает, что слушать дальше.
3. Пропустили ответ — отпустите его. Догадку впишете потом, но не переставайте слушать, иначе пропустите и следующий.
4. Во время прослушивания делайте короткие пометки, а окончательный ответ запишите аккуратно после.

body.en:
Listen to the tour guide, once.
You read three questions before she starts:
1. First stop: be back by ______
2. Where are photographs not allowed?
3. Tickets can be used again ______ for free.
Question 1: she says "Please be back on the bus by a quarter past two." Answer: 2.15. Now your eyes go to question 2: you listen for "photographs".
Now you. Question 2: Where are photographs not allowed?
1. Signpost: "Our second stop is the cathedral."
2. Listen for "allowed".
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Ekskursiya boshlovchisini bir marta tinglang.
U boshlashdan oldin uchta savolni oʻqiysiz:
1. First stop: be back by ______
2. Where are photographs not allowed?
3. Tickets can be used again ______ for free.
1-savol: u «Please be back on the bus by a quarter past two» deydi. Javob: 2.15. Endi koʻzingiz 2-savolga oʻtadi: «photographs» soʻzini kutasiz.
Endi siz. 2-savol: Where are photographs not allowed?
1. Ishora: «Our second stop is the cathedral».
2. «Allowed» soʻzini tinglang.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте гида один раз.
До начала вы читаете три вопроса:
1. First stop: be back by ______
2. Where are photographs not allowed?
3. Tickets can be used again ______ for free.
Вопрос 1: она говорит «Please be back on the bus by a quarter past two». Ответ: 2.15. Теперь взгляд переходит к вопросу 2: вы ждёте «photographs».
Теперь вы. Вопрос 2: Where are photographs not allowed?
1. Ориентир: «Our second stop is the cathedral».
2. Слушайте «allowed».
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: the most common way to lose marks in a real test is to stop and think about a missed answer while the recording goes on.
Example: you miss question 2 and keep thinking "was it the harbour?". Meanwhile the guide gives the answers to questions 3 and 4, and you miss those too. One miss becomes three.
So: if a gap stays empty, mark it, move your eyes to the next question at once, and come back at the end. Every question is worth the same mark.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: haqiqiy testda ball yoʻqotishning eng keng tarqalgan yoʻli — yozuv davom etayotganda oʻtkazib yuborilgan javob haqida toʻxtab oʻylash.
Misol: 2-savolni oʻtkazib yuborasiz va «port edimi?» deb oʻylab qolasiz. Bu orada boshlovchi 3- va 4-savollarning javoblarini aytadi, siz ularni ham oʻtkazib yuborasiz. Bitta xato uchtaga aylanadi.
Demak: boʻsh joy qolsa, belgilang, koʻzingizni darhol keyingi savolga oʻtkazing va oxirida qayting. Har bir savol bir xil ball beradi.
body.ru:
Осторожно: чаще всего баллы в настоящем тесте теряют, когда останавливаются подумать о пропущенном ответе, а запись идёт дальше.
Пример: вы пропустили вопрос 2 и всё думаете: «это был порт?». Тем временем гид называет ответы на вопросы 3 и 4, и вы пропускаете их тоже. Одна ошибка превращается в три.
Поэтому: если пропуск остался пустым, отметьте его, сразу переведите взгляд на следующий вопрос и вернитесь в конце. Каждый вопрос стоит одинаково.

body.en:
After every practice test, sort each miss into one of four kinds:
1. Did not hear it: the answer went past while you were somewhere else.
2. Heard it, but misspelt it, or left off a plural "-s".
3. Went over the word limit.
4. Chose a distractor: the first answer, the one that was later changed.
Count the four kinds. The two you have most of are what you practise next week: spelling drills for kind 2, reading the instructions for kind 3, listening to the end of the sentence for kind 4.
body.uz:
Har bir mashq testidan keyin har bir xatoni toʻrt turdan biriga ajrating:
1. Eshitmadingiz: javob siz boshqa joyda turganingizda oʻtib ketdi.
2. Eshitdingiz, lekin notoʻgʻri yozdingiz yoki koʻplikdagi «-s» ni tushirib qoldirdingiz.
3. Soʻz chegarasidan oshdingiz.
4. Chalgʻituvchi variantni tanladingiz: birinchi aytilgan, keyin oʻzgartirilgan javobni.
Toʻrt turni sanang. Eng koʻp boʻlgan ikkitasini keyingi hafta mashq qilasiz: 2-tur uchun imlo mashqlari, 3-tur uchun koʻrsatmalarni oʻqish, 4-tur uchun gapni oxirigacha tinglash.
body.ru:
После каждого пробного теста разложите ошибки по четырём видам:
1. Не услышали: ответ прозвучал, пока вы были в другом месте.
2. Услышали, но написали с ошибкой или потеряли «-s» множественного числа.
3. Превысили лимит слов.
4. Выбрали отвлекающий вариант: первый ответ, который потом изменили.
Посчитайте все четыре вида. Два самых частых — то, что вы тренируете на следующей неделе: диктанты для вида 2, чтение инструкций для вида 3, слушание фразы до конца для вида 4.

body.en:
Listen to a hotel booking and check each answer against the four kinds of miss.
Gap: Surname: ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. He says "Paul Fenwick. F-E-N-W-I-C-K."
2. A student wrote "Fenwik". That is kind 2: heard it, misspelt it.
3. Answer: Fenwick.
Now you. Gap: Price per night: £______ (breakfast included) (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Listen for the price of the room he chose.
2. Before you write, ask: is this a number I heard, and is it inside the limit?
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Mehmonxona bronini tinglang va har bir javobni toʻrt xato turi boʻyicha tekshiring.
Boʻsh joy: Surname: ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. U aytadi: «Paul Fenwick. F-E-N-W-I-C-K».
2. Bir talaba «Fenwik» deb yozgan. Bu 2-tur: eshitgan, lekin notoʻgʻri yozgan.
3. Javob: Fenwick.
Endi siz. Boʻsh joy: Price per night: £______ (breakfast included) (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. U tanlagan xona narxini tinglang.
2. Yozishdan oldin oʻylang: bu men eshitgan sonmi va chegaraga sigʻadimi?
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Послушайте бронирование в гостинице и проверьте каждый ответ по четырём видам ошибок.
Пропуск: Surname: ______ (ONE WORD ONLY)
1. Он говорит: «Paul Fenwick. F-E-N-W-I-C-K».
2. Один ученик написал «Fenwik». Это вид 2: услышал, но написал с ошибкой.
3. Ответ: Fenwick.
Теперь вы. Пропуск: Price per night: £______ (breakfast included) (ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER)
1. Слушайте цену номера, который он выбрал.
2. Перед тем как писать, спросите себя: это услышанное число и оно в пределах лимита?
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out for kind 3, the word limit. It loses marks even when you understood everything.
Example: the gap is "Keys will be left in the ______ by the front door" (ONE WORD ONLY). You heard "in the box by the front door" and wrote "box by the front door". That is five words: no mark, although the meaning is right.
The words after the gap are already on the page. Write only what is missing, then count the words.
body.uz:
3-turdan, soʻz chegarasidan ehtiyot boʻling. Hammasini tushungan boʻlsangiz ham u ball oladi.
Misol: boʻsh joy «Keys will be left in the ______ by the front door» (ONE WORD ONLY). Siz «in the box by the front door» ni eshitib, «box by the front door» deb yozdingiz. Bu besh soʻz: maʼno toʻgʻri boʻlsa ham ball yoʻq.
Boʻsh joydan keyingi soʻzlar sahifada allaqachon bor. Faqat yetishmaganini yozing, keyin soʻzlarni sanang.
body.ru:
Осторожно с видом 3, лимитом слов: он отнимает баллы, даже если вы всё поняли.
Пример: пропуск «Keys will be left in the ______ by the front door» (ONE WORD ONLY). Вы услышали «in the box by the front door» и написали «box by the front door». Это пять слов: балла нет, хотя смысл верный.
Слова после пропуска уже есть на странице. Пишите только недостающее и посчитайте слова.
